BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property tax refunds; and amending RCW84.69.030.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.69.030 and 2009 c 350 s 9 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except in cases wherein the county legislative authority acts uponits own motion, no orders for a refund under this chapter ((shall)) maybe made except on a claim: (1) Verified by the person who paid the tax, the person's guardian,executor or administrator; and (2) Filed with the county treasurer within three years after thedue date of the payment sought to be refunded; and (3) Stating the statutory ground upon which the refund is claimed.
